name: vuesp.kc868-a16
summary: KinCony KC868-A16 industrial I/O controller with 16 inputs, 16 outputs, 4 ADC and Ethernet.
description:
## Vuesp KC868-A16

Firmware for the KinCony KC868-A16 industrial controller. Sixteen opto-isolated inputs are read through I2C expanders at `0x21` and `0x22`, sixteen relay outputs are written to `0x24` and `0x25`, and four ADC channels are exposed in the dashboard.

The board supports Ethernet (LAN8720) and Wi-Fi. PlatformIO environments are provided for ESP8266, ESP32, ESP32-C3 and pico32 boards. The standard Vuesp web UI, ScriptRunner and OTA updates are included.
